evidence.reason: Harvest now rejects any repair result whose verdict reason is not a string, routing it through the existing terminal invalid-result path before publication writes the journal or pushes the branch (so finalize_publication's fix-PR table can no longer hit KeyError/AttributeError after a push), with the two previously reason-less test fixtures updated and a regression test added; tests were not run because the harness only permits git commands, so CI is the authority.
